decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back today with NASDAQ down 1.3% and S&P 500 down 0.7%, a broad risk-off session. No new candidates were screened, so we held all 7 existing positions and left cash untouched.

market_education.summary_en: Markets traded lower across the board today, with the NASDAQ falling 1.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.7%, reflecting a broad risk-off tone among investors. Technology and growth names, which make up a large share of the NASDAQ, tend to underperform on days when investors rotate toward safety. No specific news catalyst was available for today's session, so the decline appears consistent with routine market volatility rather than a single triggering event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌,納斯達克指數下跌1.3%,標普500指數下跌0.7%,反映投資者風險偏好轉弱。科技及增長股佔納指比重較大,在資金轉向避險資產時往往表現較弱。由於今日未有特定新聞事件可供引用,今次回調較大機會屬於市場正常波動,而非單一事件觸發。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Risk-off" describes a market mood where investors sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings or cash. It's a normal part of market cycles, and a well-diversified portfolio with stop-losses in place doesn't need to react to every risk-off day by selling.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off(避險)」是指投資者情緒轉趨保守,拋售增長股等風險較高的資產,轉而持有較安全的資產或現金。這是市場週期的正常現象,只要投資組合分散得宜並設有止蝕機制,毋須對每次避險日子都作出賣出反應。
